INSIDE THE PROTOCOL

From order to ownership.

Flux demonstrates a fully onchain spot order book. In a deployed protocol, orders are submitted to a smart contract, matched against resting liquidity, and settled atomically.

01 · Submit

Choose a pair, side, and amount. Limit orders reserve your practice balance.

02 · Match

Market orders execute at the displayed demo price. Crossing limit orders execute immediately; other limits remain open until cancelled.

03 · Settle

Balances update together, and an execution record appears in your trade history.

This is a browser-based simulation. No wallet, blockchain connection, deployed smart contract, or live market feed is connected. State is saved on this device.
